title: Open redirection
summary: Prove unvalidated redirect/next/return/url parameters send users off-site.
steps: Find redirect params from map (redirect, next, return, url, continue, goto) on login/OAuth/logout.
Set value to an engagement-controlled external host (https://aegis-canary.example).
compare_requests or browser: confirm Location / meta refresh / JS redirect to canary.
Try protocol-relative //evil and encoded variants only if simple case fails.
On PASS: submit_finding_candidate with request + Location evidence.
pass_signals: HTTP Location or client redirect to external canary
